text: Google Places frequently omits websiteUri even when a business has a live site — treat 'no website' as a hypothesis, not a fact, and verify manually before scoring or outreach.
evidence: manual checks found live sites for leads Places returned without websiteUri

text: Cold email from a fresh domain without SPF/DKIM/DMARC, sent to generic inboxes (info@), yields ~zero replies — deliverability and owner-direct addresses are prerequisites, not optimizations.
evidence: first cold campaign: 0 replies; postmortem traced to deliverability, list quality, copy

text: For local small-business owners, warm/in-person local channels outperform cold email — prioritize them when the lead is geographically close.
Random or Faker-generated values in specs cause nondeterministic flakes — use deterministic hardcoded values in fixtures and factories.
evidence: schedule spec flaked on Faker non-determinism; hardcoding fixed it

text: Hardcoded counts or facts in docs drift (a CLAUDE.md claimed 56 tests while 106 passed) — state invariants like 'keep pytest green' or derive numbers from command output.
Client-side-only authorization is decorative — premium/paywall gates must be enforced server-side on write endpoints; treat client checks purely as UX.
evidence: focumate backend receipt validation and RequiresSubscription were dead code; premium was client-enforced only

text: Some platform config is permanent once used (App Store bundle IDs cannot be changed) — irreversible naming/config choices deserve an explicit review gate before first submission.
evidence: bundle ID locked to com.monsoudzanaty.focusmate after the FocusMate->Intentia rename

text: ruby/setup-ruby in CI can hit a bundler executable-overwrite conflict — pin 'bundler: default' rather than fighting the installed version.
evidence: CI bundler conflict resolved with bundler: default
